Two practical notes: the CDN link is only 1280x853, so pull the 6000x4000 original from the page download for print; and the jar sits slightly right of center, so shift the A4 portrait crop about 5 percent right to keep it whole. candidates.author: hello aesthe
candidates.why: Fallback only, and its defense does not survive inspection. Page and 6000x4000 file are real and free, the mood is genuinely good (barn wood, warm side light, paper-capped jars and twine), but there is not a bell pepper in the frame: the front jar holds long thin red chilies with a bay leaf and lemon slice, the back left jar is tomatoes, the right jar is shredded red cabbage or beets. The scout called the front jar 'exactly this recipe' and it is not. As a generic preserving still-life it would read fine; as the photo facing a marinated bell pepper recipe it shows the reader the wrong vegetable.
